text:
maria: Heads-up — p99 for /v1/generate jumped ~220ms around 1767265400, right after we flipped the new routing/quota policy. small dashboard screenshot attached (no image here).
kevin: Yep I saw that. Was the quota change that limits burst->fallback to lower-tier model? :thinking: 
raj: It was. Policy change: routes over quota now weight-fallback 30% instead of 5%.
sophia: That could explain some tail but 220ms seems high for fallback weight shift alone. Are we sure the p99 is attributed to the same sample origin as before?
maria: Good Q — console shows endpoint p99 but origin column is "merged-rollup". sample_count dropped from 12k->9k at the same time.
kevin: If sampling origin switched from "client" to "aggregator" we might be mixing in longer path latency (gateway + routing).
console-bot: deploy note: routing-policy v3 applied to cluster us-west-2 at 1767265385 by @raj.
raj: Adding that — we also enabled quota-enforced throttling at the gateway level (rate-limit proxy) simultaneously.
sophia: Can someone run the raw query for p99 by sample_origin and by route_tag? e.g. 
```
SELECT percentile(latency_ms, 99) as p99, sample_origin, route_tag
FROM latency_events
WHERE route = '/v1/generate' AND ts >= 1767265200 AND ts <= 1767265600
GROUP BY sample_origin, route_tag
```
maria: I ran a trimmed version — results look like: p99 client=420ms, aggregator=640ms, fallback-route=870ms (but fallback sample count tiny).
kevin: So aggregator origin is inflating p99. Why did aggregator sampling increase? maybe we changed sampling point to post-routing for quota accounting.
sophia: That aligns with the config change log: sampling_point: POST_ROUTE was set for quota metrics to capture fallback weighting. It inadvertently changed the telemetry origin label for dashboard rollups.
raj: Oof. So dashboards are now mixing pre-route and post-route samples depending on feature toggles. We need a clear provenance label.
maria: Proposal: add an explicit "provenance" legend on pctl widgets (client | pre-route | post-route | merged) and surface sample_count by origin inline.
kevin: Also, a short-term fix: add an option to the dashboard query to force sample_origin=client for pctl SLO views.
sophia: Long-term: decouple quota telemetry sampling from dashboard rollups — keep quota sampling separate stream and never re-label main latency events.
raj: I'll revert sampling_point to PRE_ROUTE for the quota job in us-west-2 and open a PR to update docs.
maria: Action items: raj revert gating (done?), kevin implement dashboard filter option, sophia file ops/telemetry RFC.
raj: Revert scheduled in 10m and I'll post update when complete.
deploy-bot: revert-job/us-west-2 queued (job id rj-1767). :white_check_mark:
maria: Thanks all — once revert lands, let's watch p99 and then decide whether to annotate or change sampling permanently. :thumbsup:
